subject: Your 3 red flags from last month
preview_text: The pattern that emerged after you left. See what changed.
body_paragraphs: Remember that conversation you scanned three weeks ago? The one where your gut said something was off? The app just finished analyzing your full history—and the results are not what you expected.

Since you last opened Red Flag Scanner AI, we added pattern detection that connects the dots across every scan you've ever done. It found a silent thread running through your last three conversations: a subtle gaslighting sign you missed each time. 800+ users have used this to catch what they couldn't see alone.

Open the app and check your new Relationship Health Dashboard. It's been rebuilt to show you exactly where that gut feeling was right—and where you need to pay attention now. No one else knows you're looking.

One tap to see your updated toxicity score. It's the closest thing to a protective friend who tells you what your bestie won't. P.S. The anonymous mode means you can review this anywhere, even at your desk.
